complexity.notes: Sorting directly with a key on the points (e.g. sorted(points, key=...)) would avoid building the tuple list. Faster alternatives exist: ||a max-heap of size k runs in O(n log k)||, and ||quickselect (e.g. nth_element / heapq.nsmallest-style partial selection) reaches expected O(n)||.
complexity.summary: Builds (distance, point) pairs for all points, sorts them, and returns the first k points. Sorting dominates at O(n log n).
